title: Restriction of an affine dual is the sheaf dual
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian ring, W any open of Spec A, and M a finite A-module. The restriction to W of the associated sheaf of Hom_A(M,A) is isomorphic to the internal Hom of the restriction of the associated sheaf of M into the structure sheaf of W. No local freeness or boundary depth assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Use the fully faithful tilde functor and tildeSelf to send an A-linear functional M → A to a sheaf morphism tilde M → O_Spec A. The internal-Hom sections equivalence, followed by evaluation at the top open, gives a bijection with the global sections of H = Hom(tilde M,O). Construct its linear map explicitly. Additivity follows from tilde.map_add. For scalar linearity factor r times a functional as that functional followed by multiplication by r on A; tilde_scalar_section_action identifies the latter map on every open with scalar multiplication. Evaluation at the top is an equivalence: restrict a top section to each open, and use compatibility to prove the two inverse identities.

The global sections of tilde M are the finite A-module M via tilde.isoTop. Modules.isFinitePresentation_of_finite in the proved source library therefore gives finite presentation of tilde M. The structure sheaf is quasi-coherent via tildeSelf. Apply isQuasicoherent_homObj_of_isFinitePresentation to conclude that H is quasi-coherent. The linear bijection of the preceding step is an isomorphism in ModuleCat A. Apply tilde to it and compose with the affine tilde-Gamma counit, which is an isomorphism for H by quasi-coherence. This proves tilde(Dual A M) ≅ H without constructing or gluing local inverses.

Restrict the affine isomorphism to W. Use the proved overHomObjIso to identify H.over W with the internal Hom of the over-restrictions. Apply internalHom_overEquiv to carry this internal Hom through Modules.overEquiv W. The components of overFunctorEquiv identify the two transported modules with scheme restriction, and restrictUnitIso identifies the restricted structure sheaf with O_W. Apply homFunctor contravariantly to the source-module isomorphism and covariantly to the target-module isomorphism; compose these isomorphisms to get the stated result. All the equivalences and constructions apply to empty W and zero M.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_dual_restriction_comparison
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] :
    Nonempty (Modules.restrict (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (Module.Dual A M))) W.ι ≅
      SheafOfModules.homObj.{u} (R := W.toScheme.sheaf) (Modules.restrict (tilde M) W.ι)
        (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf))
